newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tie with Bankers Trust to help NCB restructure - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Tie with Bankers Trust to help NCB restructure - BOJ.

text.p: The planned business tie-up between Nippon Credit Bank (NCB) and Bankers Trust New York Corp will help NCB implement its restructuring plan smoothly, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said in a statement on Thursday.
"The (planned) tie-up will contribute greatly to a smooth implementation of NCB's restructuring plan," the BOJ said.
NCB reported to the central bank that it had basically agreed with Bankers Trust on a business tie-up, the BOJ said.
Through this tie-up, NCB said it planned to offer attractive financial products in the area of securitising assets and real estate by using each other's financial expertise, the BOJ said.
NCB said the tie-up would also make it possible for the bank to offer a variety of services to its customers even after its withdrawal from overseas operations, the BOJ said.
BOJ also said that it knew that the two banks were considering a capital tie-up.
